name: bracket-ladder-run-stated-occurrences
description: Same board as real-bracket-ladder-run-between-sets-20260817, but parsed by the CURRENT prompt, which captures what the coach stated: occurrences 5 and placement between_sets. Pins the structured half of the fix. The two fixtures are the two halves deliberately: the 'real-' one is a legacy doc with neither field, so its run row carries no total (the stored 1200m is the old tier-count guess) and the board's footnote alone tells the story; this one has the stated count, so the breakdown holds the truthful 1000m, the row prints '1km total', and the cadence reads on the row itself. Never merge them - the legacy shape must keep being exercised.
